+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import dataclasses
+import pickle
+from typing import get_type_hints
+import warnings
+
+from _pytest.mark.structures import _HiddenParam
+from _pytest.mark.structures import ParameterSet
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_public_type() -> None:
+    def case(value: object) -> pytest.ParameterSet:
+        return pytest.param(value)
+
+    assert "ParameterSet" in pytest.__all__
+    assert pytest.ParameterSet is ParameterSet
+    assert pytest.ParameterSet.__module__ == "pytest"
+    assert get_type_hints(case)["return"] is pytest.ParameterSet
+    assert get_type_hints(pytest.param)["return"] is pytest.ParameterSet
+    assert isinstance(case(42), pytest.ParameterSet)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("id", [None, "case-ä", pytest.HIDDEN_PARAM])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("multiple_marks", [False, True])
+def test_param_preserves_fields(
+    id: str | _HiddenParam | None, multiple_marks: bool
+) -> None:
+    value = object()
+    mark = pytest.mark.skip(reason="example")
+    marks = [mark, pytest.mark.xfail.mark] if multiple_marks else mark
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error")
+        parameter = pytest.param(value, 42, marks=marks, id=id)
+        other = pytest.ParameterSet.param(value, 42, marks=marks, id=id)
+    assert isinstance(parameter, pytest.ParameterSet)
+    assert parameter.values == (value, 42)
+    assert parameter.values[0] is value
+    assert parameter.marks == (marks if multiple_marks else (mark,))
+    assert parameter.id is id
+    assert other == parameter
+    with pytest.raises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
+        parameter.id = "changed"  # type: ignore[misc]
+
+
+def test_param_defaults_and_pickle() -> None:
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error")
+        parameter = pytest.param(42)
+        assert parameter.values == (42,)
+        assert parameter.marks == ()
+        assert parameter.id is None
+        assert pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(parameter)) == parameter
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("keyword", [False, True])
+def test_direct_construction_warns(keyword: bool) -> None:
+    values = [42]
+    marks = [pytest.mark.skip]
+    with pytest.warns(pytest.PytestDeprecationWarning, match="private pytest"):
+        if keyword:
+            parameter = pytest.ParameterSet(values=values, marks=marks, id="case")
+        else:
+            parameter = pytest.ParameterSet(values, marks, "case")
+    assert parameter.values is values
+    assert parameter.marks is marks
+    assert parameter.id == "case"
+
+
+def test_parametrize_factories_without_warnings(pytester: pytest.Pytester) -> None:
+    pytester.makepyfile(
+        """
+        import pytest
+
+        def case(value: int) -> pytest.ParameterSet:
+            return pytest.param(value, id="named")
+
+        @pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [case(42)])
+        def test_helper(value, request):
+            assert value == 42
+            assert request.node.name == "test_helper[named]"
+
+        @pytest.mark.parametrize(("a", "b"), [(1, 2)])
+        def test_tuple(a, b):
+            assert (a, b) == (1, 2)
+
+        @pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [42])
+        def test_scalar(value):
+            assert value == 42
+
+        @pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [])
+        def test_empty(value):
+            assert False
+
+        @pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [pytest.param(42, marks=pytest.mark.skip)])
+        def test_mark(value):
+            assert False
+        """

pure.proposal:
Expose pytest.ParameterSet as a documented public type

Export `pytest.ParameterSet` for annotating helpers returning `pytest.param()`, and identify its module as `pytest`. Preserve values, marks and IDs, keep factories warning-free, and warn on unsupported direct construction.

Add documentation, a changelog entry and contract tests covering annotations, field preservation, immutability, serialization and parametrization.

Verification performed offline:

- Compilation and `git diff --check` passed.
- Contract and mark-expression tests: 160 passed.
- Broader mark and parametrization tests: 259 passed, one xfailed, two invocation-related failures. Both failures passed when rerun with absolute source and example-directory paths.

Compatibility note: `ParameterSet` is now a frozen dataclass; previous internal tuple operations are no longer supported.

Gaps: documentation, lint and type-checking tools were unavailable. Independent review could not start because the agent tool failed. The changelog filename uses `0` pending a PR number.
